summary: Verified the CAD editor wheel-zoom passive-listener fix in CadEditorTab.jsx. All primary assertions in the review request PASSED: native non-passive wheel listener intercepts WheelEvent, preventDefault is honored on every event, viewBox grows ~1.15x on deltaY=100 (zoom out) and shrinks ~0.87x on deltaY=-100 (zoom in), Reset View restores '0 0 100 100', and a 5-event rapid burst grows viewBox monotonically (100→115→132.25→152.08→174.90) with window.scrollY remaining 0 throughout. No 'Unable to preventDefault inside passive event listener' warnings observed. Bug is fixed.

observations.issue: Selecting data-testid='cad-tool-pan' and performing mouse drag (down → move +150,+80 → up) did NOT modify viewBox x/y. Pan may require middle-mouse, spacebar-hold, or a different tool ID. Out of scope for this zoom fix, but flagging since the review request mentioned 'Pan with the Hand tool still works'. Could be a separate regression worth confirming.

action_items: Optional: confirm whether mouse-drag pan with data-testid='cad-tool-pan' should modify viewBox via left-click drag (currently doesn't). May require middle-mouse-button or spacebar modifier; if so, add a tooltip / hint.
critical_code_review_comments: CadEditorTab.jsx line 236-242: useEffect dependency array is [] but handler relies on onWheelRef.current which is reassigned every render. This pattern is correct (ref-based latest-closure), but a small comment noting that the effect intentionally has no deps to avoid re-attaching the listener would help future maintainers.
CadEditorTab.jsx is 974 lines — exceeds the >700 lines code-review guideline. Consider extracting toolbar, AI sketch panel, and pointer/zoom interaction helpers into separate modules.

Wheel handler clamps width to [5, 400] but the rapid burst can blow past 400 over time only if scale changes — current Math.min(400, ...) is correct. Confirmed values stayed within bounds in burst test (max 174.9).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zoom fix is fully verified. If pan regression needs follow-up, the tool selector is data-testid='cad-tool-pan' (12th in the toolbar). Verify whether left-drag should pan or if it requires another modifier. The wheel-zoom listener at CadEditorTab.jsx:236-242 is the native non-passive attach pattern — preserve when refactoring.
rca of the issue: Original bug: React's synthetic onWheel is registered as passive since React 17, so e.preventDefault() is silently ignored and the browser scrolls the page in addition to running the zoom handler. Fix (verified working): remove React's onWheel prop from <svg>; instead, store latest handler in a ref and attach it via svgRef.current.addEventListener('wheel', handler, { passive: false }) inside a useEffect. Also set style={{touchAction:'none', overscrollBehavior:'contain'}} to neutralize trackpad/touch scroll. All assertions pass: preventDefault.honored=true on every event, window.scrollY unchanged across single + burst dispatches.
